summary: Jasper Therapeutics filed a routine 8-K under Items 8.01 and 9.01 disclosing a press release announcing completion of enrollment in the IgA nephropathy cohort of its Phase 2 basket study of vensobafusp alfa (KP104), a bifunctional complement inhibitor. Initial interim IgAN data are expected by year-end 2026, and a new FSGS expansion cohort is planned with first dosing in Q1 2027. No financial terms, securities, board recommendations, advisors, or transactional mechanics are stated; this is an ordinary clinical development update, not a special situation.
